modules.title: Non-Linear Video Editing & Workflow Systems
modules.description: Comprehensive study of multi-track editing, proxy workflows, metadata asset management, audio-video synchronization, and professional delivery formats.

modules.title: Multi-Camera Television Studio Production
modules.description: Practical training on TV studio floor protocols, camera pedestal operation, tally intercom systems, vision mixer cut/dissolve execution, and floor management.

modules.title: Digital Audio Post-Production & Sound Design
modules.description: Dialogue cleanup, Foley sound recording, ambient track design, multi-channel mixing, loudness standards, and broadcast audio compliance.

modules.title: Cinematic Lighting Design & Camera Optics
modules.description: Three-point studio lighting, high-key and low-key setups, color temperature matching, depth-of-field control, and framing aesthetics.

modules.title: Color Grading & Digital Intermediate Mastering
modules.description: Color science, primary balancing, secondary isolation, LUT generation, HDR scopes evaluation, and cinematic look development.

modules.title: Broadcast Media Technology & Transmission Basics
modules.description: Television broadcast signal path, SDI/IP video routing, master control gallery connectivity, and distribution workflows.

learningStages.title: Foundation
learningStages.description: Orientation to media technology, camera basics, and digital audio/video fundamentals.

learningStages.title: NVQ Level 5 — Semester 1
learningStages.description: Core television studio operations, single-camera shooting, lighting techniques, and introductory non-linear editing.

learningStages.title: NVQ Level 5 — Semester 2
learningStages.description: Multi-camera television directing, vision mixing, advanced post-production, motion graphics, and audio mastering.

learningStages.title: OJT — 6 Months
learningStages.description: First intensive On-the-Job Training placement at leading national television networks and production houses.

learningStages.title: NVQ Level 5 — Remaining Semesters
learningStages.description: Specialised capstone projects, broadcast engineering, media law & ethics, and final portfolio showcase.

learningStages.title: OJT — 3 Months
learningStages.description: Final industry transition internship and professional placement leading to national diploma qualification.
